name: invoice-overdue
description: Flow 3. The bind+46d per-entity timer (contract artefact 5 concern "invoice-overdue", name invoice-overdue:<policyId>). A wake-up, not a decision: it re-reads the policy and its invoices from the platform, and acts only if the policy is still ACTIVE and an invoice is still unpaid past its due date. Moves policy_status ACTIVE -> OVERDUE, the invoice to payment_status overdue, and sends the transactional overdue notice to the broker of record (broker_config.primary_contact_email, falling back to the ops address in config.static). Idempotent structurally: a second fire finds OVERDUE and does nothing. Timer payload: {policy_id, concern, quote_id}.

static.note_result: config.result points at ASSESS because every branch runs it. A result naming a node only one branch reaches 504s an awaited run while the run succeeds.
